table.name: betfront
table.purpose: Football match betting odds: one row per match with 1X2 (home/draw/away) win odds from two different bookmakers, plus match metadata (season, kickoff, country, competition, teams).

col_001.name: season_year
col_001.description: Season year (2009-2013); likely the year the season started or the calendar year of the match.

col_003.name: country
col_003.description: Country (or region, e.g. 'europe', 'world') of the competition.

col_006.name: bookmaker1_home_odds
col_006.description: Decimal odds for home win from the first bookmaker (min ~1.04, max 47).

col_007.name: bookmaker1_draw_odds
col_007.description: Decimal odds for a draw from the first bookmaker.

col_008.name: bookmaker1_away_odds
col_008.description: Decimal odds for away win from the first bookmaker.

col_009.name: bookmaker2_home_odds
col_009.description: Decimal odds for home win from a second bookmaker; distribution mirrors col_006.

col_010.name: bookmaker2_draw_odds
col_010.description: Decimal odds for a draw from a second bookmaker; distribution mirrors col_007.

col_011.name: bookmaker2_away_odds
col_011.description: Decimal odds for away win from a second bookmaker; distribution mirrors col_008.

table.name: football_data
table.purpose: Match results and betting odds for football (soccer) league matches, mostly European, seasons ~2000-2020. One row per match. Structure matches the well-known football-data.co.uk match-results dataset: league/division metadata, teams, full-time and half-time scores, result codes, and pre-match 1X2 odds from several bookmakers.

col_001.name: season
col_001.description: Season the match belongs to, in 'YYYY/YYYY' format (e.g. 2019/2020); some rows use a bare year (e.g. '2012', '2020').

col_002.name: match_date
col_002.description: Kick-off date (and sometimes time) of the match. Range 2000-07-28 to 2020-08-04.

col_003.name: league_code
col_003.description: Short code for the league/division (E1=Premier League, E2=Championship, E3=League 1, SP1/SP2=Spanish Primera/Segunda, I1=Serie A, D2=Bundesliga 2, etc.).

col_004.name: country
col_004.description: Country of the league (England, Spain, Italy, Scotland, France, ...).

col_005.name: league_name
col_005.description: Human-readable league/division name (Premier League, Championship, Serie A, Bundesliga 2, ...).

col_006.name: referee
col_006.description: Name of the match referee (e.g. 'M Dean', 'M Atkinson'). 70% null - referee not recorded for many matches/leagues.

col_007.name: home_team
col_007.description: Home team name. Empty string for ~1046 rows (missing team info).

col_008.name: away_team
col_008.description: Away team name. Empty string for ~1046 rows.

col_009.name: full_time_home_goals
col_009.description: Goals scored by the home team at full time (0-10).

col_010.name: full_time_away_goals
col_010.description: Goals scored by the away team at full time (0-9).

col_011.name: full_time_result
col_011.description: Match result from home team's perspective: H=home win, A=away win, D=draw.

col_012.name: half_time_home_goals
col_012.description: Home team goals at half time; -1 appears in ~34k rows where half-time score was not recorded.

col_013.name: half_time_away_goals
col_013.description: Away team goals at half time; -1 = not recorded.

col_014.name: half_time_result
col_014.description: Half-time result from home team's perspective: H/A/D; 19% null (matches with no half-time data).

col_015.name: bookmaker1_home_odds
col_015.description: Pre-match decimal odds for a home win from a first bookmaker (likely Bet365 given the column ordering typical of this dataset). 66% null - odds not available for all matches.

col_016.name: bookmaker1_draw_odds
col_016.description: Pre-match decimal odds for a draw from the same first bookmaker as col_015.

col_017.name: bookmaker1_away_odds
col_017.description: Pre-match decimal odds for an away win from the same first bookmaker as col_015.

col_018.name: bookmaker2_home_odds
col_018.description: Pre-match decimal home-win odds from a second bookmaker (identity unknown; possibly Pinnacle).

col_019.name: bookmaker2_draw_odds
col_019.description: Pre-match decimal draw odds from the same second bookmaker as col_018.

col_020.name: bookmaker2_away_odds
col_020.description: Pre-match decimal away-win odds from the same second bookmaker as col_018.

col_021.name: bookmaker3_home_odds
col_021.description: Pre-match decimal home-win odds from a third bookmaker (identity unknown).

col_022.name: bookmaker3_draw_odds
col_022.description: Pre-match decimal draw odds from the same third bookmaker as col_021.

col_023.name: bookmaker3_away_odds
col_023.description: Pre-match decimal away-win odds from the same third bookmaker as col_021.

col_024.name: bookmaker4_home_odds
col_024.description: Pre-match decimal home-win odds from a fourth bookmaker (identity unknown).

col_025.name: bookmaker4_draw_odds
col_025.description: Pre-match decimal draw odds from the same fourth bookmaker as col_024.

col_026.name: bookmaker4_away_odds
col_026.description: Pre-match decimal away-win odds from the same fourth bookmaker as col_024.
